question: Which of the following letter-clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series? EM, JP, OV, TE, ?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

 First alphabet is increased to 5 positional values.

 Second alphabet is increased to multiple of 3 positional values.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c458d24d553b1b79ad213aa0ad54c7cae05de75ee96dc366476ba0630f7813d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"option (1)".**
